title: Desenvolvedor Golang Senior
description:
Código da oportunidade: 59493


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


Experiência Obrigatória

  • Desenvolver projetos utilizando linguagem Go, Java
  • AWS (Lambda, Step Function, S3, Cloud Watch, Api Gateway, EC2, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, SNS), Kafka, Terraform, GITHUB, Datadog e Inteligência Artificial.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Copywriter de Email
description:
Se você é copywriter de performance e gosta de trabalhar com dados, testes e conversão, essa vaga é para você.


Buscamos uma/um Copywriter de Email para fazer parte do time da Funnel Max.


Local de trabalho: Home office

Modelo de contratação: Contrato PJ


Conheça mais sobre a gente:


Somos uma empresa de mídia e performance especializada na monetização de bases de leads. Atuamos em parceria com grandes empresas do mercado global de saúde natural, gerando vendas por meio de campanhas de Direct Response altamente orientadas à performance, via e-mail, SMS, WhatsApp e outros canais de mídia.


Nosso dia a dia é orientado por dados, testes e otimização contínua de performance.


Valorizamos pessoas com senso de dono, capacidade analítica, criatividade e disposição para testar, aprender e evoluir rápido. Aqui, trabalhamos com foco em resultado, colaboração entre áreas e melhoria contínua.


Nossa visão de futuro é construir o maior ecossistema brasileiro de mídia na área de saúde natural com presença global. Para isso, buscamos uma/um Copywriter que nos ajude nessa missão, atuando na criação de copies e contribuindo de forma estratégica com o time de performance na otimização de campanhas.


Suas principais atividades serão:


  • Criar copies de marketing de resposta direta para campanhas de monetização em e-mail, SMS e WhatsApp;
  • Desenvolver assuntos, leads, corpos de mensagem e CTAs orientados à conversão;
  • Adaptar copies para diferentes ofertas, produtos, audiências e canais;
  • Criar variações de copy para testes e propor novas abordagens de comunicação;
  • Analisar, em conjunto com o time de Performance, os resultados das campanhas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado, concorrentes e campanhas para gerar novos ângulos de copy;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial para acelerar a criação, variação e otimização de copies;
  • Documentar aprendizados relevantes de campanhas, testes e otimizações;
  • Manter a organização das demandas e atualizar o andamento das entregas na plataforma Monday.


Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha:


  • Experiência ou familiaridade com copywriting de resposta direta, com foco em conversão e performance;
  • Capacidade de escrita persuasiva para criação de copies em e-mail, SMS e WhatsApp;
  • Capacidade de adaptar linguagem, estrutura e abordagem conforme oferta, canal e público;
  • Leitura e interpretação de métricas de campanha para apoiar melhorias de copy;
  • Capacidade de pesquisa de mercado, concorrência e novos ângulos de comunicação;
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplas demandas e cumprir prazos com consistência;
  • Domínio da língua portuguesa, com clareza, fluidez e correção gramatical;
  • Inglês funcional para leitura e análise de campanhas internacionais;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de inteligência artificial aplicadas ao processo de copy.


Será um diferencial se você:


  • Já tiver atuado em campanhas de saúde, bem-estar ou nutracêuticos;
  • Tiver experiência com ofertas internacionais;
  • Utilizar de forma avançada ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao processo de copy.


Para esta posição, o horário de trabalho e remuneração são:


  • Disponibilidade de tempo integral
  • Pretensão salarial a ser informada no processo


Benefícios:


  • Flexibilidade de horários com responsabilidade;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no Cartão Caju;
  • Cursos nas áreas de marketing, IA e tecnologia;
  • Clube do livro;
  • Day off no mês do aniversário;
  • Vale presente no aniversário;
  • Prêmio ao completar 1 ano de empresa;
  • Terapia: parceria com Psicologia Viva (1 sessão/mês);
  • Descontos em farmácias e exames laboratoriais;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Bônus de performance trimestral;
  • Recesso remunerado;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional.


Como somos:


Na Funnel Max, cumprimos o que combinamos e valorizamos o protagonismo de cada pessoa para fazer as coisas acontecerem.


Acreditamos que trabalho bem feito, com consistência, gera resultado.


Também acreditamos que pessoas valem mais do que coisas e que grandes resultados são construídos em conjunto. Aqui, sucesso é coletivo.


Esses são valores inegociáveis para nós.


Se você se identifica com esse jeito de trabalhar, queremos conhecer você.

title: Recruiting Manager - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Recruitment Manager to join our Recruiting Team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. This person must be proactive, detail-oriented, and demonstrate excellent analytical abilities, as well as teamwork and multitasking skills. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry! to accompany our strategic growth objectives in hiring personnel and key roles.


Key responsibilities:


- Collaborate in the definition and execution of the talent attraction strategy.

- Plan alternative scenarios of recruitment according to business needs.

- Design and validate best practices for the attraction, search, and selection of professionals for our vacancies in collaboration with leaders and Managers.

- Provide new ideas and solutions aimed at improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the selection processes, methods, and technology.

- Preparation of reports and metrics.


Requirements:


- At least 5 years of experience as a recruiter.

- Experience in leading teams of at least 5 people.

- Good interpersonal relationships.

- Knowledge of the IT market, both of development professionals and business profiles.

- Good command of English to get by on a day-to-day basis.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data, extract insights, and help solve problems.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating Tableau datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders on the finished product.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Tableau; develop reports according to analyst-defined specifications

- Conduct technical training.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

- Maintain and process SQL Server SPs and queries.


Requirements:


- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of Tableau administration, licensing, security, and deployment, and at least 1 year of previous work experience using Tableau.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:
Position Overview
As a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals. You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. Position title: Senior Helpdesk Support SpecialistLocation: Remote - LATAM
Key Responsibilities
  • Help supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation.
  • Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex end-user IT issues, providing advanced second-level support for computer systems, hardware, and software.
  • Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives.
  • Proactively identify recurring technical problems, implementing permanent solutions and making recommendations for IT improvements to reduce incident volume.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems.
  • Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation.
  • Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions.
  • Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets.
  • Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources.
  • Strong documentation discipline and ability to follow and improve SOPs and knowledge base articles
  • Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems.
  • Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation.
  • Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Proven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians.
  • Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools.
  • Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows.
  • Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base.
  • Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment.
Nice to Have Skills
  • Professional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks.
  • Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android.
  • Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools.
Soft Skills
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success.
  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions.
  • Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences.
  • A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity.

title: Senior Civil Engineer Designer
description:
We’re Hiring!

We have an opening available for a Senior Civil Engineer Designer in our Belo Horizonte, Brazil office.

Do you want to make a difference in the world? Are you interested in applying your skills, talents, and education to work at a company that values people and excellence; has a long history of success, and is valued by repeat clients in an industry that makes our quality of life better? Do you want to be part of a team that will inspire you and offer you opportunities to learn and grow? If you said yes to these questions, then read on to learn more about Knight Piésold and the opportunities we have open.

Why Join Knight Piésold?

  • You will be joining a reputable, well-established global consulting firm with 100 years of industry experience that specializes in Mining, Environmental, Hydropower and Water Resources.
  • We believe in the One Team approach, with everyone working together toward achieving a shared goal. There are no barriers, and no one works in isolation. You will build on your talents through knowledge-sharing culture, working across borders and collaborating with top professionals in the industry.

The Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Civil Engineer Designer responsible for the drafting of drawings and computer aided design of projects and/or project elements (largely earthworks related), taking projects from conceptual designs through refined 3D CAD models, and then to the production of detailed design drawings. Additional duties will include the calculation of various quantities from 3D models and aiding others in refining and drafting their designs.

Responsibilities:

  • Under minimal supervision, completes complex design tasks, CAD assignments, and preparation of designs for visualizations and presentations.

  • Consistently follows KP policies and procedures and demonstrates consistent application.
  • Responsible for successful delivery of work on time and on budget.


Ideal Candidate will have:

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in civil engineering or related fields.
  • Registered as a Professional Engineer.
  • 10+ years of work experience related to mining, hydropower, and/or infrastructure project development with a strong background in geotechnical analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk infrastructure design tools (e.g., Civil 3D, InfraWorks), and experience with GIS, hydraulic, hydrotechnical, and geotechnical software.
  • Proven experience and ability for project/client management.
  • Excellent communication skills and a demonstrated capability to work cooperatively within multidisciplinary teams.

title: Credit Risk Analyst -Consumer Lending
description:
Credit Risk Analyst — Consumer Lending | Digital Origination

300 Software · Remote (Brazil) · Full-time | PJ


⚠️

Before you read further: this is NOT an FP&A, Treasury, Controller, corporate credit, or FIDC role. If your background is primarily in those areas, this position is a different discipline and will likely not be a good fit.


Our US fintech client — an online consumer lender — is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst who owns the front end of the credit funnel: designing risk tiers, sequencing underwriting decisions, managing approval/decline trade-offs, and building the logic that determines who gets credit and at what terms. If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you

If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you.


What You'll Do

  • Own and iterate credit acquisition policies inside an automated decisioning engine
  • Build and validate scorecards; monitor performance through vintage analysis and population stability
  • Segment applicants by acquisition channel, product, and risk tier — and price accordingly
  • Identify emerging fraud patterns and respond with targeted policy changes
  • Work cross-functionally with US product and marketing teams to balance growth and risk
  • Write SQL to investigate, model, and monitor — no waiting on a data team


Requirements (Non Negotiable)

• 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment

• Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing

• Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English

• SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data

• Ability to work US Central Time hours (approx. 9am–6pm CT / 11am–8pm Brasília)


Nice to Have

• Experience with rescue lane management or near-miss recovery programs

• Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel

• Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration

• Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post-acquisition)

• Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance company


What We Offer

• PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates

• 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil

• US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights

• Direct exposure to a fast-growing US online lending operation


Quick Self-Screen

In your last role: were the majority of credit decisions made automatically, within seconds, for individual consumers (not companies)? If yes — we'd like to talk. If your process involved credit committees, manual case-by-case review, or business borrowers — this is a different kind of role, and it's worth being honest about that upfront.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Growth Analyst | Internship
description:
O que a Liora faz

O Brasil tem um mercado de energia elétrica de R$ 300 bilhões por ano. A maioria das pessoas paga a conta todo mês sem questionar o valor, sem entender as opções e sem receber nada em troca além do serviço básico. A Liora muda essa equação.


A gente transforma a conta de luz em um produto financeiro — com cashback real, acesso a crédito e uma experiência que faz sentido para quem usa. O cliente economiza, a gente cresce, e o dinheiro que antes ficava parado numa conta de concessionária começa a circular de volta pra vida das pessoas.


Não é uma ideia. Em três meses de 2026 já dobramos de tamanho. A projeção é crescer 15x até dezembro. Temos backing de Canary, 17Sigma e 468 Capital — fundos que apostam em empresas com potencial de redefinir mercados inteiros. Se você quer entender como uma empresa assim é construída por dentro, essa vaga é o caminho mais curto.


Desafio

O mercado de energia é complexo, muito regulado e historicamente resistente à mudança. Isso significa que a maioria dos brasileiros ainda não sabe que pode escolher de onde vem sua energia — e os que sabem, muitas vezes não confiam em quem oferece.


Escalar num mercado assim exige mais do que anúncio bem feito — exige entender o que faz uma pessoa confiar, decidir e agir. Quem entrar nessa vaga vai trabalhar exatamente nisso: entender o que quebra a resistência do cliente, o que gera conversão de verdade e como transformar esse aprendizado num processo que escala.


Meta/Google Ads, Metabase, SQL, Python, N8N e Sheets são apenas ferramentas. O trabalho real é entender por que algo funciona — e saber replicar isso em escala sem perder a eficiência.


Por que essa vaga é diferente

A maioria das vagas \"de marketing\" te coloca pra promover posts, reportar métricas e esperar aprovação de três camadas hierárquicas. Essa não.


Você vai sentar do lado de quem toma decisão desde o primeiro mês. Vai ter acesso aos números reais da empresa — CAC, LTV, taxa de conversão por canal, por criativo, por oferta. Vai propor experimentos, defender sua lógica e ver o resultado aparecer em tempo real. É o tipo de exposição que a maioria das pessoas leva anos pra conseguir. Aqui você tem isso desde o começo.


Perfil que buscamos

Você não precisa ter experiência em marketing, em energia ou em nenhuma área específica. Você precisa:

  • Gostar de números de verdade — não só de ler dashboard, mas de questionar o que está por trás dele.
  • Conseguir pegar um problema confuso e quebrar em partes que podem ser testadas
  • Ter mais curiosidade do que certeza, e mais disposição pra errar rápido do que medo de estar errado
  • Ser ambicioso no sentido real da palavra — alguém que pensa em construir algo grande, não só em ter um emprego que paga bem


Se você está na faculdade, querendo mais do que aula teórica, e quer entender como uma empresa de verdade cresce na prática — essa vaga é pra você!

description:

No dia a dia, você vai

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços e aplicações que suportam jornadas relevantes do produto.
  • Atuar em parceria com Produto e Engenharia desde o refinamento técnico até a implementação, deploy e acompanhamento em produção.
  • Contribuir com decisões técnicas e com a evolução contínua das soluções, considerando manutenção, performance, confiabilidade e experiência do usuário.
  • Investigar e solucionar problemas em produção, apoiando a estabilidade e a melhoria contínua do produto.
  • Colaborar com o fortalecimento das práticas de engenharia, incluindo testes, observabilidade, documentação e qualidade de código.
  • Participar da construção de soluções com olhar para contexto de negócio, sustentabilidade técnica e evolução contínua do produto.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência como Full Stack Developer , com boa capacidade de atuar entre backend, integrações e demais camadas da aplicação.
  • Base consistente em backend , com familiaridade para navegar em um contexto full stack.
  • Vivência em ambiente de produto , com proximidade de áreas parceiras e foco em evolução contínua.
  • Experiência com integrações, sistemas distribuídos ou cenários com volume relevante de dados e transações.
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia, boa leitura de contexto e responsabilidade sobre a qualidade da solução.
  • Perfil maduro, com senso de ownership, colaboração e visão crítica sobre o que está sendo construído.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Proficiência em TypeScript/Node.js e/ou Python .
  • Experiência com APIs, microserviços e integrações .
  • Vivência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Conhecimento de cloud, CI/CD e observabilidade.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times de engenharia, produto e stakeholders.


Stack atual

Backend e serviços:

TypeScript / Node.js, Python (FastAPI, Django), Express

Persistência:

PostgreSQL, TypeORM, SQLAlchemy, Django ORM, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Firebase

Mensageria e cache:

Redis / ElastiCache, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Kinesis

Infra e cloud:

Kubernetes, GCP e AWS, Cloud Functions, Lambda, EC2, Cloud Storage / S3

CI/CD, observabilidade e plataforma:

GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, ArgoCD, Terraform, Helm, New Relic, GCP Monitoring, Grafana, CloudWatch, Vault, Doppler, GrowthBook


Importante

Você não precisa ter profundidade em todas as tecnologias da stack. O mais importante é ter experiência sólida em desenvolvimento, boa autonomia e disposição para atuar em um contexto de produto.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Qualificações

Envie via inbox:

  • Uma gravação real de call de vendas  para análise


Se você sabe fechar vendas de forma consistente  e quer crescer em um ambiente de alta performance, essa é sua oportunidade.

title: Analista de Publicidade Pleno
description:
A Unimed Campinas acredita no poder da diversidade para juntos conectarmos experiências, promovendo a troca e fazermos a diferença no propósito de cuidar das pessoas! Por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, etc. Todos são bem vindos!

Quer fazer parte? Então confira a oportunidade abaixo!

A Unimed Campinas busca um(a) Analista de Publicidade Pleno para atuar de forma estratégica na área de Marketing, desenvolvendo e implementando ações de publicidade nos meios online e offline. O objetivo é apoiar o alcance das metas da cooperativa e atender às necessidades dos diversos públicos envolvidos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gestão de Tráfego Pago: Planejar e acompanhar configuração e otimização das campanhas no Google, Meta (Facebook/Instagram) e TikTok em conjunto com agência digital.

Estratégia de Conversão: Criar/direcionar e gerenciar, junto a agência, testes A/B de criativos, públicos e Landing Pages para maximizar a taxa de conversão (CRO).

Gestão Orçamentária: Controle de budget, recomendação e direcionamento da distribuição de verba entre canais com base em ROAS e CPA.

Alinhamento de Funil (Marketing + Vendas): Estabelecer uma rotina de feedback com o time comercial para entender a qualidade dos leads e ajustar as campanhas em tempo real.

Análise de Dados: Monitorar KPIs de funil completo (CPL, taxa de conversão) e gerar relatórios que direcionem a tomada de decisão.

Atender e realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo, conforme orientação e solicitação do superior imediato, quando aplicável.


Requisitos:

Ensino superior completo: Marketing ou Publicidade e Propaganda;

Experiência em gestão de grandes volumes de investimento em Google, Meta e TikTok Ads;

Domínio de ferramentas de análise e rastreamento (Google Analytics, Tag Manager);

Habilidade em estruturação de segmentações avançadas e funis de remarketing;

Conhecimento em estratégias voltado para conversão e técnicas de CRO;

Conhecimento de ferramentas de CRM e automação de Marketing, como RD Station, para integração de leads.

Conhecimento dos meios de comunicação/mídia


Modelo atual de trabalho: híbrido após 90 dias da data de admissão

Benefícios

  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio academia
  • Auxílio estacionamento
  • Vale Transporte
  • Auxílio farmácia
  • Programa de treinamentos
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale Refeição

title: Analista de Sistemas Sênior - SRE
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.


Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças



Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Engenheiro de Plataforma Sênior (SRE), que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Atuação no Metro Conceição região sul de São Paulo no modelo hibrido


Nessa função você vai:


O Programa Apollo tem como objetivo a modernização da plataforma no que se refere às operações de recebíveis. A estrutura da modernização está baseada em uma arquitetura de referência, orquestrado e coreografado por um orquestrador (ou hub de pagamentos).



  • Cultura DevOps (especialmente Observabilidade)
  • Infraestrutura AWS
  • Administração de sistemas Linux



Tecnologia: - Administração de sistemas Linux , - Kubernetes (especialmente EKS) , - Helm , - GitOps (especialmente ArgoCD) , - Cultura DevOps (especialmente Observabilidade) , - Infraestrutura AWS



Desejável Certificação: AWS Cloud Practitioner , SRE Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Foundation. , desejavel outro certificado AWS




Ao se tornar um ituber você tem


  • Vale-Transporte
  • Vale-Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale-Alimentação (Supermercados)
  • Plano médico (Fundação Saúde Itaú ou Central Nacional Unimed)
  • Plano odontológico (Odontoprev ou Interodonto)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco)
  • Previdência privada
  • Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Auxílio Creche / Babá (para papais e mamães)
  • Incentivo a estudos
  • Wellhub ou TotalPass
  • Acesso aos Clubes de Lazer Itaú (Guarapiranga / Itanhaém e São Sebastião)
  • + Algumas vantagens que você pode conhecer durante o processo

title: Copywriter de Email
description:
Se você é copywriter de performance e gosta de trabalhar com dados, testes e conversão, essa vaga é para você.


Buscamos uma/um Copywriter de Email para fazer parte do time da Funnel Max.


Local de trabalho: Home office

Modelo de contratação: Contrato PJ


Conheça mais sobre a gente:


Somos uma empresa de mídia e performance especializada na monetização de bases de leads. Atuamos em parceria com grandes empresas do mercado global de saúde natural, gerando vendas por meio de campanhas de Direct Response altamente orientadas à performance, via e-mail, SMS, WhatsApp e outros canais de mídia.


Nosso dia a dia é orientado por dados, testes e otimização contínua de performance.


Valorizamos pessoas com senso de dono, capacidade analítica, criatividade e disposição para testar, aprender e evoluir rápido. Aqui, trabalhamos com foco em resultado, colaboração entre áreas e melhoria contínua.


Nossa visão de futuro é construir o maior ecossistema brasileiro de mídia na área de saúde natural com presença global. Para isso, buscamos uma/um Copywriter que nos ajude nessa missão, atuando na criação de copies e contribuindo de forma estratégica com o time de performance na otimização de campanhas.


Suas principais atividades serão:


  • Criar copies de marketing de resposta direta para campanhas de monetização em e-mail, SMS e WhatsApp;
  • Desenvolver assuntos, leads, corpos de mensagem e CTAs orientados à conversão;
  • Adaptar copies para diferentes ofertas, produtos, audiências e canais;
  • Criar variações de copy para testes e propor novas abordagens de comunicação;
  • Analisar, em conjunto com o time de Performance, os resultados das campanhas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado, concorrentes e campanhas para gerar novos ângulos de copy;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial para acelerar a criação, variação e otimização de copies;
  • Documentar aprendizados relevantes de campanhas, testes e otimizações;
  • Manter a organização das demandas e atualizar o andamento das entregas na plataforma Monday.


Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha:


  • Experiência ou familiaridade com copywriting de resposta direta, com foco em conversão e performance;
  • Capacidade de escrita persuasiva para criação de copies em e-mail, SMS e WhatsApp;
  • Capacidade de adaptar linguagem, estrutura e abordagem conforme oferta, canal e público;
  • Leitura e interpretação de métricas de campanha para apoiar melhorias de copy;
  • Capacidade de pesquisa de mercado, concorrência e novos ângulos de comunicação;
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplas demandas e cumprir prazos com consistência;
  • Domínio da língua portuguesa, com clareza, fluidez e correção gramatical;
  • Inglês funcional para leitura e análise de campanhas internacionais;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de inteligência artificial aplicadas ao processo de copy.


Será um diferencial se você:


  • Já tiver atuado em campanhas de saúde, bem-estar ou nutracêuticos;
  • Tiver experiência com ofertas internacionais;
  • Utilizar de forma avançada ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao processo de copy.


Para esta posição, o horário de trabalho e remuneração são:


  • Disponibilidade de tempo integral
  • Pretensão salarial a ser informada no processo


Benefícios:


  • Flexibilidade de horários com responsabilidade;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no Cartão Caju;
  • Cursos nas áreas de marketing, IA e tecnologia;
  • Clube do livro;
  • Day off no mês do aniversário;
  • Vale presente no aniversário;
  • Prêmio ao completar 1 ano de empresa;
  • Terapia: parceria com Psicologia Viva (1 sessão/mês);
  • Descontos em farmácias e exames laboratoriais;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Bônus de performance trimestral;
  • Recesso remunerado;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional.


Como somos:


Na Funnel Max, cumprimos o que combinamos e valorizamos o protagonismo de cada pessoa para fazer as coisas acontecerem.


Acreditamos que trabalho bem feito, com consistência, gera resultado.


Também acreditamos que pessoas valem mais do que coisas e que grandes resultados são construídos em conjunto. Aqui, sucesso é coletivo.


Esses são valores inegociáveis para nós.


Se você se identifica com esse jeito de trabalhar, queremos conhecer você.

title: B2B Partner Comercial
description:
Tem perfil hunter, busca novos horizontes na sua carreira e quer potencializar sua rede de contatos?


Então venha trabalhar no Grupo AG Capital e faça parte do modelo de atuação que está revolucionando o mercado tributário brasileiro - e moldando a carreira de centenas de executivos e empreendedores.


Quem somos


O Grupo AG Capital possui uma sólida trajetória de resultados em compliance tributário. Listada entre as empresas que mais cresceram no Brasil em 2022 e 2023 (Rankings Deloitte e Revista Exame, PWC e BTG Pactual).


Atuação com tecnologia tributária especializada, com mais de 13 mil clientes (sendo 15% das empresas listadas na B3) e mais de R$ 8 BI recuperados.


Empresas do Grupo AG Capital:


AG: Primeira TaxTech do Brasil e maior especialista no setor previdenciário desde 2010.


AG Tax: Operação especializada e com base tecnológica focada na recuperação de tributos diretos e indiretos.


Agnes: O primeiro monitor tributário de folha de pagamento e SST do Brasil. Tecnologia proprietária e pioneira a nível global.


Quem estamos buscando:


Profissionais experientes com mente empreendedora, postura de dono e atuação consultiva.


B2B Sales Partners do Grupo AG Capital contam com amplo treinamento sobre mercado e soluções, e nas reuniões com clientes é acompanhado do seu gestor comercial e profissionais da equipe técnica - com ampla estrutura tecnológica e time de suporte.


Desafios da posição


1. Desenvolvimento de novos negócios


2. Relacionamento com clientes


3. Networking qualificado


4. Estratégia de venda consultiva


5. Alianças estratégicas com rede de contatos


6. Desenvolvimento de parcerias


7. Identificação de oportunidades de negócio


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Fomentar e gerenciar sua carteira de empresas para fornecer soluções de produtos e desenvolver novos negócios (Empresas Lucro Presumido e Real);

Ser o principal ponto de contato com os clientes. Fornecemos todo o suporte comercial para concretização do negócio com equipe técnica alocada e ferramentas tecnológicas;

Vontade de crescer e gerar resultados, com resiliência para prospectar sempre e buscar novas oportunidades;

Trajetória de sucesso na gestão de clientes;

Familiaridade com as métricas de desempenho de vendas;

Habilidades de apresentação e comunicação e postura corporativa profissional.


Principais perfis Business Partners (palavras-chave)


Gerentes Bancos, Gerente PJ, Gerente Regional. Parceiro de Negócios, Business Partner, Consultor Empresarial, Consultor RH, Representante Comercial com Carteira (PJ). Gerente Empresas, Gerente Plataformas, Contabilidade, FOPAG. Advogado. Consultor Tributário. Executivo Comercial. Contador.


Bacharelado nas áreas de RH, Marketing, Comercial, Economia, Administração, Direito, Finanças e correlacionados;


Remuneração agressiva acima do mercado. 


VARIÁVEL


Início imediato.


Setor


Tecnologia da informação e serviços

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:
Position Overview
As a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals. You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. Position title: Senior Helpdesk Support SpecialistLocation: Remote - LATAM
Key Responsibilities
  • Help supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation.
  • Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex end-user IT issues, providing advanced second-level support for computer systems, hardware, and software.
  • Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives.
  • Proactively identify recurring technical problems, implementing permanent solutions and making recommendations for IT improvements to reduce incident volume.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems.
  • Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation.
  • Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions.
  • Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets.
  • Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources.
  • Strong documentation discipline and ability to follow and improve SOPs and knowledge base articles
  • Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems.
  • Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation.
  • Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Proven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians.
  • Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools.
  • Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows.
  • Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base.
  • Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment.
Nice to Have Skills
  • Professional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks.
  • Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android.
  • Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools.
Soft Skills
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success.
  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions.
  • Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences.
  • A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity.
  • Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets.
Why You Will Love Working with Us
Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology Professional development opportunities with international customers Collaborative work environment Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusiveenvironment for all employees.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Account Executive
description:
A Accountfy está crescendo e estamos buscando um(a) AE que queira crescer junto.

Se você sabe conduzir conversas complexas com tomadores de decisão, transformar dores em argumentos de valor e fechar negócios com consistência, essa pode ser a sua próxima casa.


O que você vai fazer

Você será o ponto central entre o cliente e a solução, do primeiro diagnóstico ao contrato assinado. Seu trabalho não é empurrar software: é entender o contexto do cliente e mostrar, com clareza, como a Accountfy muda o jogo para ele.


Na prática, isso significa:

  • Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas, da prospecção ao fechamento;
  • Mapear dores e construir propostas com foco em ROI, produtividade e inteligência financeira;
  • Apresentar para C-levels e tomadores de decisão com confiança e profundidade;
  • Colaborar com pré-vendas, produto e implantação para garantir uma jornada sem atritos;
  • Usar o CRM com disciplina e orientar suas decisões por dados.


O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B de soluções complexas ou customizáveis;
  • Histórico com clientes Enterprise ou Mid-Market;
  • Capacidade de conduzir o funil completo com autonomia;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa e habilidade de influenciar sem pressionar.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Familiaridade com o universo financeiro: DRE, FP&A, fechamento contábil (não precisa ser contador, precisa saber conversar com um);
  • Experiência com SaaS financeiro, ERP ou soluções de gestão para escritórios contábeis ou departamentos financeiros.

  • Conhecimento em métricas de CS, como churn, retenção, expansão e indicadores de satisfação.
  • Familiaridade com ambiente digital e ferramentas de gestão.
  • Perfil comunicativo, analítico e com forte foco em resolução de problemas.


Diferencial: Liderança em e-commerce


O que oferecemos:

  • Modelo de trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Bônus mensal por resultados.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.

title: Operations Quality & Performance Expert
description:
Let’s talk about Keeta

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan, one of the world’s largest delivery platforms. Our mission is bold: to revolutionize the delivery of food and everyday products across the globe. Our motto says it all: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With our Brazil launch approaching, we are expanding quickly and building a world-class team from the ground up. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex operational challenges, and want to make a visible impact, this could be the right opportunity for you.


About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Operations Quality & Performance Expert to drive operational excellence through data, quality control, and performance tracking.

In this role, you will monitor key processes, ensure compliance with standards, and identify opportunities to improve execution quality. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate data insights into actionable improvements and support the achievement of business targets.


What You’ll Do ⭐

  • Monitor adherence to SOPs, SLAs, and quality standards across operations
  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring accuracy and consistency of data
  • Evaluate operational performance against business goals and identify gaps or deviations
  • Conduct root cause analysis on performance or compliance issues and structure actionable insights
  • Drive and follow up on improvement initiatives to enhance quality and operational efficiency
  • Build and deliver regular reports on performance, compliance, and target achievement
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure alignment on processes, metrics, and execution priorities


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience in operations, performance management, quality, compliance, or data analysis
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into insights and actions
  • Experience with KPI tracking, dashboards, and reporting (with tools like Excel, SQL, or BI platforms)
  • High attention to detail and a structured, problem-solving mindset
  • Ability to manage tasks independently and follow through with execution
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills


Why Join Us

  • Be part of building and scaling a new global delivery platform from the ground up
  • Work in a dynamic environment where analytical insights directly influence operational performance
  • Collaborate with talented teams across product, engineering, and operations
  • Join a culture that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning


Ready to jump in?

title: Delivery Operations Specialist
description:
1. Platform Launch & Operations Management

  • Onboarding & Store Setup: Managed store registration, menu configuration, and inventory synchronization across major delivery platforms including Rappi, DiDi, and Uber Eats .
  • Content & Accuracy Management: Ensured 100% accuracy of store information, including high-quality visuals, SKU listings, pricing, operating hours, and geolocation data.
  • Platform Partnership: Liaised with platform account managers to secure strategic resources, premium traffic placements, and favorable promotional policies.

2. Data Monitoring & Performance Optimization

  • KPI Tracking: Monitored daily operational metrics, including order volume, Average Order Value (AOV), Click-Through Rate (CTR), and Conversion Rate (CVR).
  • Traffic Analysis: Analyzed traffic composition (organic vs. paid/campaign traffic) to evaluate channel effectiveness.
  • Promotion Execution: Assisted in designing and executing promotional strategies such as tiered discounts, digital coupons, and loyalty point programs.
  • Feedback Loop: Monitored user reviews and ratings to identify pain points and drive improvements in store service quality.

3. Store Coordination & Standardization

  • Operational Training: Coordinated with frontline staff to streamline delivery workflows, covering meal preparation, professional packaging, and courier handovers.
  • Efficiency Improvement: Tracked fulfillment metrics (e.g., preparation time and order accuracy) to enhance operational efficiency and reduce error rates.
  • SOP Development: Participated in drafting and implementing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for delivery operations to ensure service consistency.

4. Marketing & Brand Promotion

  • Campaign Management: Planned and executed co-branded marketing initiatives, including flash sales and seasonal/holiday promotions.
  • ROI Optimization: Tracked and analyzed the ROI and exposure performance of platform advertisements (Paid Search/Display).
  • Competitive Intelligence: Collected and analyzed competitor pricing and promotional activities to provide actionable market insights.

5. Systems & Data Integration

  • Data Integration: Facilitated the integration of third-party delivery data into Mixue’s proprietary systems (B-System/Data Mid-platform) .
  • Account Maintenance: Managed and updated centralized store account databases.
  • Reporting: Generated periodic analytical reports (weekly/monthly) and provided data-driven recommendations for operational improvements.

title: Merchant Acquisition Strategy Sr. Manager
description:
Role Summary


As the Merchant Acquisition Strategy Manager , you will shape how Keeta grows its merchant supply in Brazil. This is a strategy and analytics role, not a customer-facing account management position. You'll work at the intersection of data, market knowledge, and commercial judgment: building a clear view of the merchant landscape, and designing the playbooks that give our business development teams a real edge.


Key Responsibilities

1. Merchant Targeting & Prioritization

  • Build and maintain a structured view of the merchant landscape, segmented by category, price tier, and geography, to define acquisition priorities.
  • Identify high-quality merchant targets by combining platform data with on-the-ground market knowledge — knowing not just who to sign, but why and when.
  • Continuously refine the target pipeline based on evolving business needs and market dynamics.

2. Acquisition Strategy & Proposition Design

  • Develop differentiated acquisition strategies for different merchant segments, including value propositions, timing, and resource allocation logic.
  • Assess brand and merchant value to determine appropriate partnership terms and investment levels.
  • Translate platform capabilities — traffic placements, promotional support, operational resources — into compelling, merchant-specific propositions.

3. Market Intelligence

  • Develop a deep, current understanding of Brazil's F&B and restaurant ecosystem: which categories are growing, which brands are underserved, and what drives merchant decision-making on platform choice.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape and surface actionable insights to inform strategy and prioritization.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with business development teams to ensure strategies translate into executable, on-the-ground playbooks.
  • Partner with Product, Operations, and Marketing to align platform capabilities with merchant acquisition needs.
  • Collaborate with Sales Operations on data infrastructure and reporting; your focus is the strategy layer, not pipeline administration.


Basic Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in strategy, merchant/supply operations, or business development at a platform or marketplace company.
  • Strong analytical skills — able to work with large datasets, use SQL or BI tools, and turn analysis into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Deep knowledge of the food delivery or local services industry , including how merchants evaluate and engage with platforms.
  • Fluent English ; Portuguese fluency strongly preferred for local market effectiveness.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a leading food delivery or on-demand platform — you understand the competitive dynamics from the inside.
  • Background in supply strategy, merchant growth, or commercial strategy with a demonstrated track record of building and executing acquisition playbooks.
  • Ability to assess merchant and brand value — focused on sign quality, not just sign volume.
  • Consulting or structured problem-solving background is a plus.
  • Comfortable building from scratch in a fast-moving environment where not everything has a playbook yet.


Why Join Keeta?

  • Own the strategy, not just execute it. You'll define who we go after and how — with real influence over outcomes.
  • Brazil's F&B market is genuinely complex. The problems here require real analytical depth and local market intuition — it's not a market where generic playbooks work.
  • High-impact, high-visibility work. Merchant supply quality is one of the core levers of platform growth, and this role sits at the center of it.
